title: Sum-Rate Constraint induces Partial Participation and Bidirectional Compression
titleZh: 总通信速率约束如何诱导部分参与和双向压缩
summaryZh: 将节点参与、梯度压缩和下行通信统一为每轮总通信速率约束，提出 EF21-SR，通过参与数量与压缩精度的权衡及码字重广播，减少分布式优化的通信开销。
abstract: Communication-efficient distributed optimization typically treats compression, partial worker participation, and downlink communication as separate design choices. We show that they can instead arise from a single resource constraint: a hard per-round sum-rate ($\textbf{SR}$) constraint on the aggregate communication rate of the workers, $\sum_{i=1}^n R_t^i \leq R$. The budget $R$ creates a direct tradeoff between participation and compression fidelity: involving more workers leaves fewer bits available for each update. Under a common-broadcast downlink of rate $R$, the server can then rebroadcast the received worker codewords so that all workers reconstruct the global state without an additional lossy server-side compressor. We instantiate this principle in $\textbf{EF21-SR}$, a resource-constrained variant of the popular EF21 error-feedback method. We establish $\mathcal{O}(1/T)$ convergence to stationarity under heterogeneous compression. Experiments show that EF21-SR requires the least cumulative communication to approach the target among the compared methods with tuned stepsizes on both classification and least-squares problems.
classificationReason: 研究对象是受通信资源约束的分布式优化，主线是统一节点参与与压缩配置，而非一般模型量化。
